project.title: MES Acceptance D - Editable Remotion Export
project.description: Create a 15.6 second narrated documentary montage at EXACTLY 24 fps using only real open motion footage from NASA and/or Wikimedia Commons. Use the supplied narration exactly. Music is explicitly opted out, so the mix is narration only. Honour the supplied locked timeline: 24 fps, the four locked scene boundaries, and the 0.5s crossfade. Fill each locked gap scene with real motion footage. In addition to the final MP4 you MUST export a SELF-CONTAINED editable Remotion project under editable/remotion that an unrelated third party can install and render on its own machine: its own package.json with pinned dependencies and a "render" script, all composition sources, every referenced asset copied inside the project (for example public/) and referenced by RELATIVE path only (never an absolute path into the MES or OpenMontage checkouts), and a README.md stating the exact install and render commands. Do not use still-image substitutes, fixtures, generated video, Pexels, or Pixabay.

production.style: restrained archival science documentary; real motion footage only
